<?php

trait Loggable {
    public function log($msg) {
        echo $msg;
    }
}

class Shape {
    use Loggable;

    private $sides;

    public function __construct($sides) {
        $this->sides = $sides;
    }

    public static function make($sides) {
        return new self($sides);
    }

    public function describe() {
        if ($this->sides > 4) {
            return "polygon";
        }
        return "shape";
    }
}

class Circle extends Shape {
    public function area($radius) {
        return 3.14 * $radius * $radius;
    }
}

function classify_status($status) {
    return match ($status) {
        'ok' => 1,
        'warn' => 2,
        'error' => 3,
        default => 0,
    };
}

function makeAnonymous() {
    return new class {
        public function run() {
            return true;
        }
    };
}
